selection_rule: per source, the n lowest by score: fail-to-pass plus pass-to-pass test count, plus gold patch size in KB, plus 1000 per non-.py file in the gold patch; ties by instance_id; repos on the deny list are left out (astropy/astropy, matplotlib/matplotlib, numpy/numpy, pandas-dev/pandas, scikit-learn/scikit-learn, scipy/scipy)
